text:
product-claire: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — below is a compact recap of the Q&A action items and clarifications. I captured the bits folks asked for live. I'll update the wiki after this thread. TL;DR: Dedicated GA moved to July, Private beta in May, Optimize suggestions rolling next week. Links and owners below.

cto-sanjay: Quick clarifier — Dedicated GA target is the week of 2025-07-14 (still soft). We're shifting one sprint to finish the autoscaler stability fixes.

eng-lead-ryan: For rollout behavior: default canary will be 10% for 24h, then 50% for 24h, auto-rollback on 5xx spike > 3% or latency p50 regression > 30%. Config exposed as:```json
{"canary":10,"stage_duration_h":24,"rollback_conditions":["5xx>3%","p50>30%"]}
```

ops-maya: Private deployment beta (VPC/on-prem) starts internal onboarding May 5. Customers with compliance needs: we'll enable KMS/HSM integrations and extended audit logs (retention 90d default). Please file RED-2401 to request >90d.

product-claire: Actions and owners (short list):
- Dedicated GA readiness: @cto-sanjay, @eng-lead-ryan — due 2025-06-30
- Private beta invites + onboarding doc: @ops-maya — due 2025-05-02
- Optimize rollout (suggested batching/quant profiles): @eng-lead-ryan, publish pattern examples — due 2025-04-11
- Customer comms draft for GA + FAQ: @mktg-jordan — due 2025-05-15
- Console docs: canary UI & rollback explainer: @design-anya + @eng-lead-ryan — due 2025-04-18
(I'm creating tickets and linking them below) :spiral_calendar:

mktg-jordan: For the customer comms — can someone share the short list of what will be gated for Dedicated GA vs features that remain hosted-only? I want to avoid surprises.

cto-sanjay: Gated for GA: SLA-backed uptime, reserved capacity controls, burst capacity, and single-tenant pools. Hosted API features (larger model catalog, some early opt features) will remain behind feature flags initially.

design-anya: I'll put a short UI microcopy doc in the docs repo with screenshots. Link after I upload: https://redwood.internal/docs/canary-ui-proposal (will update by Thurs). :camera_flash:

eng-lead-ryan: One follow-up on metrics: make sure the rollout traces include per-model token breakdowns. Ops, can we add an ops dashboard panel?

ops-maya: Yep — created RED-2470 to add per-model token panels and canary health. Dashboard preview: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary-health. Deploy bot scheduled the dashboard job for 04/08.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Job deploy/canary-dashboard scheduled for 2025-04-08 02:30 UTC — CI pipeline ID: ci-98234. :robot_face:

product-claire: Open asks from Q&A I didn't assign (please claim here if you want):
- deeper cost model example for large multitenant customers (requested by enterprise sales)
- sample migration checklist for teams moving from hosted -> dedicated
- compliance checklist for SOC2/ISO mapping on Private

eng-lead-ryan: I'll take the migration checklist, will drop a first pass by 2025-04-15.

ops-maya: I'll own the compliance mapping. Filing RED-2500 now.

mktg-jordan: I'll draft the cost model one-pager with ops numbers if someone can share expected per-token unit costs for the main profiles.

product-claire: Great — I'll open the parent tracking ticket RED-2600 and post links here when done. Final note: if you were called out above, please add a comment in the ticket with estimated time. I'll close the loop by EOD tomorrow and surface any blockers to leadership. Ping me directly or DM if you need reassignments. :handshake:
